title: people-ops
text:
people-ops

Taylor (People Ops): Heads up — small interviewer coverage reshuffle for Thu 10am slot. Need 1 scribe + 1 debrief lead. Also the panel will be asked to look at a small CR; whoever is on the 10am panel can you paste the PR link here?

alex: I can take scribe for 10am. Will post CR link in a sec.

priya: Thanks Alex! Can you also confirm microphone + live-transcript access for the candidate? Need consent noted.

alex: Yep mic + live transcript OK. Consent form already sent to candidate.

samir: FYI I can cover debrief lead if needed, but I have a merge window at 11:00 — prefer someone else if the debrief can be 11:30.

elena: If Samir is backup that's fine. I'd prefer debrief at 11:30 then. @Taylor can you update the calendar invite and add the Zoom passcode in the description?

Taylor (People Ops): Will do — updating invite now. Alex please drop the CR link here and call out 2–3 small areas to watch (e.g. perf, edge cases, compatibility).

alex: CR: https://git.redwood.com/r/infer/PR/8423 — focus on `request_queue.py`, `batcher.py`, and `compat/legacy_adapter.py`. Main things: potential deadlock on high-concurrency, batch boundary off-by-one, and legacy adapter handling of missing keys.

elena: Adding rubric note — please use the standard `interview-lite` rubric and explicitly mark `code-readability` and `test-coverage` as required. Ping me if we need to adjust weights.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll call out tests in PR comments and highlight likely follow-ups in the debrief doc.

priya: Quick reminder — scribe should capture a one-line summary + two action items in the debrief doc. Template: https://redwood.share/interviews/debrief-template (copy into meeting notes).

samir: Putting backup note in my calendar now. If anything slips 11:30 -> 12:00 I can still cover.

Taylor (People Ops): Thanks everyone — invite updated and passcode added. Closing the loop here. If anyone needs to swap out before EOD, flag in this thread.
